# Endocrinology Advisor

> A comprehensive clinical resource for endocrinologists and healthcare professionals covering diabetes, obesity, thyroid disease, and metabolic disorders with news, CME education, and diagnostic tools.

Endocrinology Advisor provides evidence-based clinical information, continuing education credits, and specialty-specific news across major endocrine conditions. The site serves as a hub for professional development and staying current with clinical guidelines, drug approvals, and research updates in endocrinology and related specialties.

## Key Topics

- Type 2 Diabetes Management
- GLP-1 Receptor Agonists
- Obesity Treatment
- Clinical Guidelines
- Thyroid Disease
- Adrenal Disorders
- Pediatric Endocrinology
- Cardiovascular Endocrinology
- Bone Health & Osteoporosis
- Neuroendocrinology
- Dyslipidemia Management
- CME/CE Accreditation
- Clinical Research
- FDA Drug Approvals
- AACE & AAOS Guidelines

## Clinical Education & CME

- [Endocrinology CME/CE Courses](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/endocrinology-cme-courses): CME/CE courses with AMA PRA credit and ABIM MOC points for endocrinology professionals
- [Special Collections](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/special-collections): Curated clinical education collections including case studies and diagnostic tools
- [Clinical Quiz Archives](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/hm-article-type/clinical-quiz): Clinical quizzes for knowledge assessment in endocrinology and related specialties

## Specialty News Archives

- [Diabetes News & Updates](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/diabetes): Diabetes news covering GLP-1 agonists, treatment outcomes, and drug safety
- [Obesity Treatment News](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/obesity): Obesity treatment news featuring GLP-1 receptor agonists and weight management
- [Adrenal Disorders](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/adrenal): News and guidelines on adrenal disorders including Cushing syndrome and aldosteronism
- [Neuroendocrinology](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/neuroendocrinology): Clinical news on pituitary disorders, acromegaly, and neuroendocrine tumors
- [Bone Health](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/bone-health): Clinical news on osteoporosis, bone mineral density, and treatment guidelines
- [Cardiovascular Endocrinology](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/cardiovascular-endocrinology): Clinical news on cardiovascular endocrinology and metabolic dysfunction
- [Pediatric Endocrinology](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/pediatric-endocrinology): Pediatric endocrinology news on childhood obesity and growth disorders
- [Lipoprotein Metabolism Disorders](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/disorders-of-lipoprotein-metabolism): News on dyslipidemia management and familial hypercholesterolemia treatment
- [General Endocrinology](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/general-endocrinology): General endocrinology news on hormone therapy and drug approvals

## Clinical Reference & Resources

- [Diagnosis & Disease Information](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/ddi): Clinical reference guide for endocrine disease diagnosis and information
- [Fact Sheets](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/hm-article-type/fact-sheets): Fact sheets on diabetes medications including metformin and GLP-1 agonists

## News & Feature Articles

- [News Archive](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/news): Archive of endocrinology news covering clinical research, guidelines updates, and healthcare policy
- [Features Archive](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/features): Archive of feature articles on diabetes management, thyroid disease, and clinical guidelines

## Professional Events

- [Conferences](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/conferences): Directory of endocrinology conferences from major professional organizations

## Optional

- [General Medicine News](https://www.endocrinologyadvisor.com/subjects/general-medicine): General medicine news covering clinical updates and health policy
